correctness.rationale: Induction on the marker cylinder with Kac tower and Abramov entropy formula correctly allows an all-zero atom. Single-symbol entropy and KL inequality upper-bound h_mu/t by log Z(s)+s/t; equality forces zero atom absent, exponential iid return law and unique stationary renewal lift. The mean return length m(s)=-(log Z)^prime strictly falls from infinity to 2, yielding a unique s(t) for every t in (0,1/2). Poisson summation of A(s)=sum exp(-s n²) yields sqrt(pi)/(2sqrt(s))-1/2 plus exponentially small theta tail. For the elementary surrogate the stationary equation becomes 2pi w²(1-w)=t/(1-t); strict convexity in local s-window and minimizer comparison yield E/t error O(exp(-pi²/t)). Real analytic implicit branch in sqrt(t) supplies every coefficient. Independent 45-digit direct series and bisection at t=0.01 and .005 agreed with the cubic formula at 2.5e-33, a check not an asymptotic proof.

value.rationale: Fixed-marker-density entropy is a natural thermodynamic invariant for gap shifts; square gaps create a Gaussian theta regime rather than geometric-gap log-periodic behavior. The convergent half-power coefficient germ and exponentially small nonperturbative error quantify a motivated exact transition and explain uniqueness of equilibrium at each density.

final_claim: In the square-gap binary renewal shift, for each marker density 0<t<1/2 there is a unique maximizing invariant renewal measure, and as t->0 its entropy per marker equals log((1-w)/(2w))+1/[2(1-w)]+O(exp(-pi²/t)), w satisfying 2pi w²(1-w)=t/(1-t).
limitations: Only binary square-gap shift, density 0<t<1/2, asymptotic t->0. Moderate t not covered by exponential surrogate. Unindexed exact theta/renewal analysis may exist. Raw blob streams not separately rehashed, publication withheld.
